newsitem.title: USA: Nabors files $350 mln debt, equity shelf.
newsitem.headline: Nabors files $350 mln debt, equity shelf.

text.p: Nabors Industries Inc. said Tuesday it filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission of up to $350 million in debt securities, preferred, common shares, depositary shares and warrants.
Of the securities to be registered in the shelf offering, the company said a group of stock holders may offer up to $50 million in common shares.

The Houston, Texas drilling company said it will use the proceeds from the securities it sells to finance future business acquisitions, general corporate needs, working capital needs and to repay outstanding debt.
NO underwriters were named in the filing.
